about_the_game:
• [Fate punches hard. Your choice is the rule.]

The strongest fist will always strike the tenth rib of the most fragile destiny.Your choice is the only rule of the game, the fork in the road of destiny, the end has long arrived before the choice, whether to re-emerge on the throne of the boxing ring, or sink into the maze of love?The story begins, choose a different life that belongs to you.

 

  • [Three lines intertwine to unveil the hidden truths]

King of Fighters, Revenge Line, Cure Line, three lines of destiny, three very different life experiences, but all centered around the same story truth - the peak of the retired King of Fighters, in the end, why fall out of favor?Find the plot fragments in different story lines and reason out the answers behind.

 

  • [Hundreds of variations of girlfriend, you decide what she looks like]

Victory in the ring may belong to you, but in the love ring, the bamboo horse sister, Miss Heavenly descent, or a capable manager ......Who will you be defeated by?Character settings are rich and diverse, unlock their exclusive skin POV, from dress up to character, all-round customization belongs to your "her".

 

  • [Multiple interactions, immersive experience of the boxing world.]

Full dynamic real-life interactive movie and television works, you will be the former boxing champion's point of view to explore the truth behind.The game includes a wealth of interactive experiences: boxing battle, exploration and puzzle solving, destiny decision, red face interaction...Through immersive emotional resonance to bring you a wonderful boxing story!

 

  • [Audio-visual feast, we are all here for you]

Experienced product development team in the industry, powerful lead actors with both face value and acting skills, and quality celebrities with millions of fans guest starring...Everything is designed to create the ultimate gaming experience for you.

 

I Can't Beat The Pretty Ones" is in the process of filming and production, and will bring you more game production content and details in the future, waiting for a better way to meet you, welcome you to join the wish list first, the surprise is in the near future!

name: 我打不过漂亮的她们

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 或 AMD equivalent 或以上
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 780 or AMD HD 7950 with 3GB VRAM minimum (Support of Vulkan 1.1 required)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 或 AMD equivalent 或以上
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 with 4GB VRAM minimum (Support of Vulkan 1.1 required)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Shi Lei once ruled the underground world and retired at his peak. Years later, unsettling truths emerge, disrupting his peace. Will he resolve old issues or break free from fate to uncover the secrets behind these truths? This time, he won't face it alone; she will help him.
